string.text: If enabled, the air in all locations will become radioactive and when leaving the safe zone you will regularly inhale radioactive dust, which will also increase the rate of degradation of filters. The more northerly a location is, the more polluted the air is. If your respiratory organs have insufficient protection from radiation (filter/oxygen tank/cloth headgear), then you will regularly become infected with radiation. Suits and the effect of increased radioprotection from drugs do not affect the amount of radiation received from radioactive air.

It affects the total amount of radiation received from radioactive air if the protection of the filter/oxygen tank/cloth headgear is insufficient. The higher your protection is and the lower the multiplier value, the slower the radiation infection occurs (1.0 by default).

If enabled, then when you are in radioactive fields, you will additionally become infected with radiation when your radio protection is insufficient without taking into account the helmet. Filters, oxygen tanks, and breath retention do not affect the amount of radiation that this mechanic adds.

It affects the total amount of radiation received after subtracting your radio protection without taking into account the helmet. The higher your protection is and the lower the multiplier value, the slower the radiation infection occurs (0.15 by default).
Penetrating radiation causes damage to health

If enabled, then when you are in radioactive fields, you will receive direct damage to your health when your radio protection is insufficient without taking into account the helmet. Filters, oxygen tanks, and breath retention do not affect the damage received.

It affects the total amount of health damage from radioactive fields after subtracting your radio protection without taking into account the helmet. The higher your defense is and the lower the multiplier value, the less damage you will take (0.25 by default).
Allow the use of breath retention.
Disable/Enable filter changing animation and tank camera animation (for equipped items only).
Disable/Enable Metro-style watch alarm sound effects and news popup when filter reaches 15% (short alarm) and when filter reaches 0% (long alarm).

Standard mode. If there are several filters with different radioprotection, the filter with the best protection will always be selected. This mode also takes into account the helmet's radio protection, which acts as a limitation. If there is no filter with protection equal to that of a helmet, then the best filter available with lower radio protection will be selected. Filters with protection higher than that of a helmet will be ignored.
Do not install or select a filter if its condition is below the specified value (0.15 = 15% by default).
Limit the installation of filters with high radioprotection

This option will be useful if you use a helmet with high radioprotection (40% or higher) and carry high-protection filters in your inventory that you do not want to install using the standard filter replacement mode.
The range of filter installation restrictions
If the restriction is enabled, filters with radio protection above this value (0.4 - 40% by default) will be ignored when selected. This option only affects the standard filter installation mode.
Alternative mode. If there are several filters with different radioprotection, the filter with the worst protection will always be selected. Helmet radio protection is not taken into account here.
Limit the installation of filters with low radioprotection
This option will be useful if you want filters with protection above the specified value to be selected when using the alternative mode.
The range of filter installation restrictions

If the restriction is enabled, filters with radioprotection equal to or below this value (0.4 - 40% by default) will be ignored when selected. This option only affects the alternative filter setting mode.
Displays the name of the installed filter or a message about its absence.
When the filter check is activated, in addition to its name, the approximate condition will also be shown using text.
If enabled, damage will be caused without sufficient chemical protection, and the condition of the filters will decrease faster.
Multiplier of toxic damage that you receive when air protection is not high enough. \n \n Default: 1.0
Degradation multiplier of filter. It affects the rate degradation depending on location, being in radioactive and chemical zones, and presence toxic air at location. \n \n Default: 1.0
Multiplier for oxygen tank's air flow rate. \n \n Default: 1.0
Multiplier for amount of items (filters/tanks) to appear at trader's inventory. \n \n Default: 1.0
Disable/Enable choking sound effects when in a toxic area without high enough air protection.
Disable/Enable screen effects when in a toxic area without high enough air protection.
Spawn items from corpses with a certain chance
If enabled, the item spawn will depend on the drop chance set below. If disabled, a filter or oxygen tank will always appear on corpses.
The higher the value, the greater the chance of item spawn (0.5 = 50% by default).
Increasing the maximum condition of items

By default, the maximum possible condition of items appearing in the inventory of corpses does not exceed 30% on average. This parameter increases their maximum possible condition. By setting the value to 0.25 (0 by default), you will increase the maximum possible condition of the drop-down items by 25%. That is, expand the state range from about 5-30% to 5-55%.
DELETE ALL TANKS ON NEXT LOAD
Works only after installation on compatible headgear or outfit.
Works only with a scientific air-supply system.
